apple-app-attestation-root-ca.pem.evidence: Downloaded over HTTPS from apple.com. Apple publishes no fingerprint. The intermediate certificate in Apple's sample attestation (apple-sample-attestation.json, from developer.apple.com) verifies against this root.

third-party/block-buzz-ios27-assertion.j.evidence: A real iOS 27 assertion with Apple's extensions in authenticatorData (flags 0xC0). The file is unchanged from the pull request's head commit. The pull request was open, not merged, on 2026-10-12.

apple-sample-attestation-2024.json.originalSource: Apple's Attestation Object Validation Guide (developer.apple.com), 2024 version
apple-sample-attestation-2024.json.evidence: The certificate chain verifies to the pinned root, so Apple made the credential certificate and the nonce in it; the nonce binds authData and the client data hash. The receipt is outside the signed data and is not proven. The source repository has no license file; the bytes are Apple's published sample data.

third-party/arkavo-macos27-attestation.j.evidence: A real attestation from macOS 27.0 (com.arkavo.ArkavoCreator, captured 2026-09-20 by its developer). Its platform field is macosx and its access-control blob is the one Apple documents for macOS. The file is unchanged from the upstream commit.
